decisions.reason: It is strongly validated by named government use and broad scheme connectivity, making it a strategic, proven fit with our aviation and border-security offer.
Although travel-health compliance demand may be less urgent by 2024, it still complements our passenger-processing portfolio and can be retained for customers needing regulatory flexibility.
Cyber awareness training fits our training capabilities and customers’ rising security needs, so it is worth keeping as a scalable cross-sell product.
Behaviour analysis supports our high-risk site security positioning, and despite likely longer sales cycles it remains strategically aligned with integrated security solutions.
Passenger profiling is the most exposed to regulatory, reputational, and customer-acceptance risks, and with weak visible market traction it is the best candidate to withdraw.
Document verification is close to our core offer, useful to transport and border-related clients, and its standalone web platform suggests a solid product commitment.
